latestVersion.changelog:
Envato Free Video Generation — v1.0.0

- Initial public release.
- Instantly generate 1080p videos from product descriptions and up to three brand images, without using paid Envato assets.
- Fast cloud rendering: upload, describe, and download your video in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports uploads in common video, image, and audio formats (mp4, mov, avi, jpg, png, mp3, etc.).
- Automated session setup with free trial tokens (100 credits, valid for 7 days) for new users.
- Simple workflow covers import, edit, preview, and export, with easy status updates and error handling.
